facts.note: At the nine o'clock temple strike the husband had everyone show watches. Félix's watch read twenty minutes to nine, and the husband rebuked him in front of everyone, calling the watch a disgrace to the family. The husband is identified as Aurèle by context.
At the temple's ten o'clock strike she looked at the mantel clock in the salon, which read five minutes to ten.
She and the doctor (Casimir) played piquet in the salon without a break until he went out for his cigars, at twenty-eight minutes past ten by the salon clock.

The transcript says he asked her to play 'before he went'. The sheet says he asked 'as he went out'. That changes the order between the request and his departure. The rest matches: she sat at the piano at once, played until he returned, and stopped when he came in.
A moment after the doctor returned, the hall clock struck eleven.

added.quote: Before he went, he asked me to play for him.
added.why: Gives an order between two events: the request to play came before the doctor left the salon. The sheet only says it came 'as he went out', so this puts the request earlier than the sheet places it.
